issue.title: SQL: negative numbers are treated as ALIAS instead of literals in functions

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.title: SQL: CAST doesn't work in ORDER BY

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
On the surface it might look similar to #33361, but it is causing an exception in painless rather then in planner, so I think it's a separate issue. To reproduce:
```
DELETE test

PUT test/doc/1
{
  "foo": "42"
}

POST _xpack/sql?format=text/plain
{
  "query": """
      SELECT foo, CAST(foo.keyword AS DOUBLE) test_str FROM "test" ORDER BY foo.keyword
      """
}

POST _xpack/sql?format=text/plain
{
  "query": """
      SELECT foo, CAST(foo.keyword AS DOUBLE) test_str FROM "test" ORDER BY test_str
      """
}
```

The first SELECT statement works, but the second causes the exception:
```
{
  "error": {
    "root_cause": [
      {
        "type": "script_exception",
        "reason": "runtime error",
        "script_stack": [
          "doc[params.v0].value",
          "              ^---- HERE"
        ],
        "script": "doc[params.v0].value",
        "lang": "painless"
      }
    ],
    "type": "search_phase_execution_exception",
    "reason": "all shards failed",
    "phase": "query",
    "grouped": true,
    "failed_shards": [
      {
        "shard": 0,
        "index": "test",
        "node": "o8qIS4EtReu3fksMhbWqdQ",
        "reason": {

          "reason": "runtime error",

          }
        }

    ]
  },
  "status": 400
}
```

issue.title: SQL: Add basic support for ST_AsWKT geo function

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Adds basic support for ST_AsWKT function. The function takes accepts
geo shape or geo point and returns its WKT representation.
